name: Tailscale
description: Tailscale client from the official tarball on pkgs.tailscale.com, run without root in userspace networking mode. Start it with minibox-tailscale up, which prints the login URL.
requires: Userspace networking. Inbound TCP and UDP to the box's tailnet IP are forwarded to 127.0.0.1 in the box, so programs listening on localhost or 0.0.0.0 are reachable from the tailnet. Outbound connections to tailnet hosts go through the SOCKS5 and HTTP proxy at localhost:1055 (ALL_PROXY=socks5h://localhost:1055). No ICMP (use minibox-tailscale ping). Run minibox-tailscale up again after the box restarts or wakes.
install:
set -eu
d=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$d"' EXIT
base=https://pkgs.tailscale.com/stable
curl -fsSL "$base/?mode=json" -o "$d/index.json"
case "$(uname -m)" in
  x86_64 | amd64) arch=amd64 ;;
  aarch64 | arm64) arch=arm64 ;;
  *) echo "unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
tarball=$(jq -r --arg arch "$arch" '.Tarballs[$arch] // empty' "$d/index.json")
case "$tarball" in
  tailscale_[0-9]*_"$arch".tgz) ;;
  *) echo "no usable tailscale tarball for $arch in $base/?mode=json (got: $tarball)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
curl -fsSL "$base/$tarball" -o "$d/tailscale.tgz"
curl -fsSL "$base/$tarball.sha256" -o "$d/tailscale.sha256"
sum=$(awk '{ print $1; exit }' "$d/tailscale.sha256")
case "$sum" in
  *[!0-9a-f]* | "") echo "malformed sha256 for $tarball" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
[ "${#sum}" -eq 64 ] || { echo "malformed sha256 for $tarball" >&2; exit 1; }
printf '%s  %s\n' "$sum" "$d/tailscale.tgz" | sha256sum -c -
tar -xzf "$d/tailscale.tgz" -C "$d"
src="$d/${tarball%.tgz}"
[ -x "$src/tailscale" ] && [ -x "$src/tailscaled" ] || { echo "unexpected layout in $tarball" >&2; exit 1; }
mkdir -p {{prefix}}/bin
for name in tailscaled tailscale; do
  cp "$src/$name" {{prefix}}/bin/.$name.new
  chmod 0755 {{prefix}}/bin/.$name.new
  mv -f {{prefix}}/bin/.$name.new {{prefix}}/bin/$name
done
cat > {{prefix}}/bin/.minibox-tailscale.new <<'MBTS'
#!/bin/sh
# minibox-tailscale runs tailscaled in userspace networking mode for this box, as its user and without root.
#   up [flags]   start tailscaled when it is not running, then `tailscale up`, which prints the login URL
#   stop         stop tailscaled when it is running
#   <command>    any other tailscale command, such as status, ip or ping
set -eu

bin={{prefix}}/bin
state="${HOME:?}/.local/state/tailscale"
sock="$state/tailscaled.sock"
pidfile="$state/tailscaled.pid"
log="$state/tailscaled.log"
proxy=localhost:1055

die() {
  echo "minibox-tailscale: $*" >&2
  exit 1
}

usage() {
  cat <<USAGE
usage: minibox-tailscale up [tailscale up flags]   start tailscaled if needed and log in (prints the login URL)
       minibox-tailscale stop                       stop tailscaled
       minibox-tailscale <command> [args]           run a tailscale command, such as status, ip or ping

Other programs reach tailnet hosts through the proxy: ALL_PROXY=socks5h://localhost:1055
(an HTTP proxy listens on the same port). Inbound tailnet TCP and UDP are forwarded to 127.0.0.1 in the box.
tailscaled does not start again by itself after the box restarts or wakes: run minibox-tailscale up again.
USAGE
}

ts() {
  "$bin/tailscale" --socket="$sock" "$@"
}

running() {
  ts status --json >/dev/null 2>&1
}

# A zombie has exited already. It is only waiting for its parent to reap it.
exited() {
  case "$(cat "/proc/$1/stat" 2>/dev/null)" in
    "" | *") Z "* | *") X "*) return 0 ;;
  esac
  return 1
}

# The pid file names a live tailscaled. /proc/<pid>/comm guards against a reused pid.
alive() {
  p=$(cat "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ -n "$p" ] && [ "$(cat "/proc/$p/comm" 2>/dev/null || true)" = tailscaled ] && ! exited "$p"
}

start() {
  mkdir -p -m 700 "$state"
  exec 9>"$state/start.lock"
  flock 9
  if ! running; then
    # A daemon that is still starting (or stuck) keeps its pid file. Wait for it instead of starting a second one.
    if ! alive; then
      rm -f "$sock"
      ( setsid sh -c 'echo $$ >"$1"; shift; exec "$@"' sh "$pidfile" \
        "$bin/tailscaled" --tun=userspace-networking --state="$state/tailscaled.state" --socket="$sock" \
        --socks5-server="$proxy" --outbound-http-proxy-listen="$proxy" \
        </dev/null >"$log" 2>&1 9>&- & )
    fi
    i=0
    until running; do
      i=$((i + 1))
      if [ "$i" -gt 100 ]; then
        tail -n 5 "$log" >&2
        die "tailscaled did not start, see $log"
      fi
      sleep 0.1
    done
  fi
  exec 9>&-
}

stop() {
  pid=$(cat "$pidfile" 2>/dev/null || true)
  if [ -z "$pid" ] || [ "$(cat "/proc/$pid/comm" 2>/dev/null || true)" != tailscaled ]; then
    rm -f "$pidfile" "$sock"
    echo "tailscaled is not running"
    return 0
  fi
  kill "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
  i=0
  until exited "$pid"; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    [ "$i" -le 100 ] || die "tailscaled ($pid) did not exit after SIGTERM"
    sleep 0.1
  done
  rm -f "$pidfile" "$sock"
  echo "tailscaled stopped"
}

case "${1:-}" in
  up)
    shift
    start
    exec "$bin/tailscale" --socket="$sock" up "$@"
    ;;
  stop)
    stop
    ;;
  "" | -h | --help | help)
    usage
    ;;
  *)
    [ -S "$sock" ] || die "tailscaled is not running; start it with: minibox-tailscale up"
    exec "$bin/tailscale" --socket="$sock" "$@"
    ;;
esac
MBTS
chmod 0755 {{prefix}}/bin/.minibox-tailscale.new
mv -f {{prefix}}/bin/.minibox-tailscale.new {{prefix}}/bin/minibox-tailscale
echo "installed tailscale $(jq -r .Version "$d/index.json") ($arch) into {{prefix}}/bin"
